action_scale_location: raw action -> environment scale -> unchanged interior anchor -> original QP; replay stores raw action
architecture: frozen balanced B interior-anchor Z/Omega; unchanged Gm/Bj inactive in no-jump Experiment I
reward_scope: out-of-W RPI event/excess remains excluded from replay reward and fully audited
baseline: same architecture zero residual; NOT ECC2019 RL-NMPC

selection_rules.hard_gate: all validation physical/input/QP/Omega counts zero; W diagnostic only
selection_rules.economics: every validation seed J_policy<=1.005 J_base (1% also reported)
selection_rules.hierarchy: post-warmup, empirical safety, 0.5% comparability, min/p1/p5 margin and near-boundary fraction, disturbance rejection, control quality, economics tie-break
selection_rules.selection_ties: exact lexicographic tuple, no scalar weighted sum; Pareto comparison tolerance 1e-10
selection_rules.boundary_occupancy: reported, not an invented absolute rejection threshold
selection_rules.sweet_spot: review full validation Pareto front; never select smallest alpha automatically
selection_rules.scope: implementation choice for reproduction; not specified in the paper

evaluation_stop_rule: after each fixed paired evaluation, any baseline/SAC physical/input/QP/Omega anomaly stops before further training; W alone does not stop
empirical_G_definition: L2 norm of fixed-B state error / L2 norm of disturbance standardized by literal standard deviations; not Hinf gain

paper_specification.source: Zanon, Gros, Bemporad, ECC 2019, Numerical Example pp. 2261-2262 and Fig. 2 p. 2263
paper_specification.paper_feed_flow_notation_note: prose says flow F2, variance subscript says F1; project plant uses exogenous F1
paper_specification.paper_model_equations_and_economic_cost: omitted in ECC2019; referred to earlier publications
paper_specification.paper_gain_baselines: 14% vs naive-initial-guess NMPC; 12% vs nominal-economic-tuned NMPC
paper_specification.paper_state_relaxation: all state bounds softened by s_k in Eq. (3e); W_s=I and w_s=1 in Numerical Example; exact solver handling not specified in the paper
paper_specification.paper_fig2_horizon: horizontal axis shown 0-1000; textual simulation horizon not specified in the paper
paper_specification.paper_fig2_cost_difference_sign: not algebraically specified in the paper; plotted values are mostly negative

implementation_choice_for_reproduction.negative_F1_X1_clipping: clip to zero, count each clip
implementation_choice_for_reproduction.training_observation: 23D: original 19D plus [0,0,0,normalized Omega q radius]; no future information
implementation_choice_for_reproduction.finite_jump_supervisor: not used in no-state-jump Experiment I; unchanged in Experiment III
implementation_choice_for_reproduction.state_constraints: unchanged hard physical constraints, unlike the paper's softened NMPC state bounds
